description.value:
Ronsos are a race of many-colored furred lion-like humanoids, standing above two meters, feline in appearance.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Ronsos gain +2 Strength, +2 Wisdom, and –2 Charisma.
  • Type: Ronsos are humanoids with the ronso subtype.
  • Size: Ronsos are Medium creatures.
  • Base Speed: Ronsos have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Ronsos begin play speaking Common and Ronsaur. Ronsos with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Galkan, Giant, Goblin, Lalafellan, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Arctic Fur: Ronsos are immune to environmental cold damage and gain Ice Resistance 5.
  • Fearless: Ronsos receive a +2 racial bonus on saves against fear spells and effects.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Intimidating Build: Ronsos gain a +2 racial bonus on intimidation checks.
  • Mountaineers: Ronsos gain a +2 racial bonus on Climb checks and are immune to altitude sickness.
  • Survivalist: Ronsos gain a +2 racial bonus on all Survival checks.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Gore: Ronsos can use their horns as a natural attack dealing 1d6 points of damage.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Darkvision: All ronsos can see perfectly in the dark up to 60 feet.

Weakness Racial Traits

  • Stand On Your Own Feet: Ronsos take a –2 penalty to all Fly and Ride checks.
